packageRules.description: @aws-sdk/middleware-websocket keeps a caret range, the same kind pi-ai's @aws-sdk/client-bedrock-runtime asks for, so npm and pnpm resolve one copy for both and the aws-websocket-abort-signal patch reaches the class the Bedrock client uses.
slicc-agent-5 is the newest 5.x agent: the integration tests run it as a follower and guest of another version against this 6.x owner, so it stays on 5.x.
pi 1.5.1 and later make Chord v2 the package root and remove Chord v1, which our remoting layer is built on (#972): these stay on 1.5.0 until the move is planned.
